nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 tracking token balances; written by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 allowance; written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Public token name string 'DENMARK_WINS'.
Public token symbol string 'DENWI'.
Public uint8 decimals value 18.
Public total token supply, minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Constructor: assigns the whole totalSupply to balanceOf[msg.sender] and emits Transfer.
transfer(address to, uint256 value): checks sender balance, deducts from sender, credits recipient, emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint256 value): sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value): checks balance and allowance, moves tokens and decrements allowance.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance owner key across all functions.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value in transfer; unchecked arithmetic on user-influenced balance.
balanceOf[to] += value in transfer; unchecked arithmetic credit to attacker-chosen address.
balanceOf[from] -= value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic on the source balance.
balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic credit to attacker-chosen address.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value in transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic on allowance.
allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value in approve; state write keyed by caller-controlled addresses.
Parameter 'to' of transfer(address to, uint256 value).
Parameter 'value' of transfer(address to, uint256 value).
Parameter 'spender' of approve(address spender, uint256 value).
Parameter 'value' of approve(address spender, uint256 value).
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value).
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value).
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value).

edges.reason: Constructor reads totalSupply to initialize the deployer balance and emit Transfer.
Constructor uses caller-controlled msg.sender as the recipient of the entire initial supply.
transfer reads balanceOf[msg.sender] for the require check and writes the deducted balance.
transfer indexes balanceOf with caller-controlled msg.sender.
transfer executes the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value.
transfer executes the unchecked addition balanceOf[to] += value.
msg.sender is the account whose balance is decremented.
User-supplied value determines the subtracted amount.
User-supplied value determines the credited amount.
Attacker-chosen 'to' is the mapping key credited with the transferred value.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
approve keys the allowance with caller-controlled msg.sender as owner.
approve executes the state write allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value.
Owner index of the allowance write comes from msg.sender.
User-supplied spender becomes the allowance key.
User-supplied value is stored as the allowance amount.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[from] and balanceOf[to].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses caller-controlled msg.sender as the spender in the allowance check.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[from] -= value.
transferFrom executes the unchecked addition balanceOf[to] += value.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented.
User-supplied 'from' is the mapping key whose balance is reduced.
User-supplied 'to' is the mapping key credited in transferFrom.
User-supplied value determines the amount subtracted from the source balance.
User-supplied value determines the amount added to the destination balance.
User-supplied value determines the allowance decrement.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter only exists to index the balanceOf credit performed by the unsafe addition in transfer.
The 'value' parameter flows directly into the unchecked balance subtraction in transfer.
The 'spender' parameter is used only as a key in the allowance state write of approve.
The 'value' parameter is stored directly by the allowance state write of approve.
The 'from' parameter is the key of the unchecked balance subtraction in transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is the key of the balance credit performed in transferFrom.
The 'value' parameter drives the unchecked allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
